name: 05-latex-display-block
why: The block contains two sentence-ending periods. Splitting on them would cut a display equation in half and produce steps no annotator could label.

calls.reasoning:
The path reduces each side of the garden by twice its width, so both dimensions shrink.
\[
\text{Inner length}=24-2(1.5)=21\ \text{m}. \qquad \text{Inner width}=18-2(1.5)=15\ \text{m}.
\]
So the inner area is 21 times 15, which is 315 square metres in total here.
